name: Long dead end: reverse continues while both sides are blocked
expected: Tick 3: boxed in at (4,2): Direction = Backward, Clean = clean_off.
Tick 4: front interrupt F = false while reversing: no action (C15).
Ticks 6-8: the 3-tick minimum is reached but L and R are still both blocked, so reversing continues (C9). No outputs.
Tick 9: at (4,8) the sides are free: Direction = Turn Left. The reverse lasted 6 ticks (3-8).
function_text: EF-10 – Boxed in (F, L, R): move backward for at least 3 ticks, continue while both sides are blocked
EF-11 – Reverse ends with a turn, left first
EF-16 – Front interrupt during a turn or reverse is not acted on
EF-09 – Cleaning stopped (clean_off) only while turning or reversing
